notes: This phase defines the stable two-level display continuum only; it does not assign existing historical entities to subregions.
Search results, Person count, and current density never alter band positions or widths.
A later Spatial Compile phase may use reviewed Place/PolityPlaceFunction evidence to select subregion precision; otherwise the macroregion center remains the honest fallback.
The taxonomy is a screen-space navigation structure and must not be stored as if it were a historical border or polity fact.
The production v1 nine-column renderer remains authoritative until the later v2 renderer cutover.
